**Design note.** The deck follows the trustees’ decision: proposal → evidence and limits → cost → staffing condition → authorization and review. Large editorial type, warm paper, forest green and a rust-colored extension marker give it a library-like character without a slide template. A proportionate hours diagram anchors the opening; a dark budget slide changes the pace. On phones, content stacks and scrolls while navigation remains available. Slide links preserve position and browser history.
